title: Pulsar 510 Jetpack 2.0 Forced Air Battery
description:
Advanced Forced Air Vapor Technology

The Pulsar DL 510 Jetpack 2.0 represents a significant advancement in portable vapor technology, combining variable voltage control with an innovative forced air system. Powered by a substantial 650mAh battery, this premium vaporizer features precise temperature control and consistent vapor delivery.0

Key Features:
Variable Voltage: Adjustable power settings for customized vapor production
Forced Air System: Advanced airflow technology for consistent vapor delivery
High Capacity Battery: 650mAh rechargeable battery for extended use
Premium Construction: Durable materials with ergonomic design
Universal Compatibility: 510 threading for maximum versatility

Specifications:
Type: Forced Air Vaporizer
Model: DL 510 Jetpack 2.0
Battery Capacity: 650mAh
Feature: Variable Voltage Control (1.8-3.8V)
System: Forced Air Technology
Color: Black, Blue, Assorted Colors, Green, Purple
Compatibility: 510 Thread

The Pulsar DL 510 Jetpack 2.0 stands at the forefront of portable vapor technology, offering retailers a premium product that combines advanced features with user-friendly operation. The forced air system ensures consistent vapor production, while the variable voltage control provides users with customizable performance options.

PULSAR DL V3 TWIST AND V5.0 ALSO AVAILABLE
